title: Grateful Dead Live at Grand Prix Racecourse on 1973-07-27

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording captures a soaring 1973 performance highlighted by an epic pre‑Wharf Rat jam and stellar ensemble playing.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy, tight ensemble work and a phenomenal second‑set jam that flows into Wharf Rat. Reviewers note the recording’s clear, well‑balanced matrix mix that lets every instrument shine, especially the cymbal work, Keith's late‑coming electric piano fury, and the intricate interplay among Jerry, Phil, Bob and Bill.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive (5‑star except one 4‑star) and highlight both an outstanding musical performance and a clear, well‑balanced recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced mix with good soundstage; captures jams cleanly. No reported dropouts or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Good set list with smooth transitions, memorable stage banter, and a soaring second‑set jam that leads into Wharf Rat.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his pick‑and‑finger technique and overall ensemble contribution; noted as a key element of the superb playing.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for lower‑register exploration during the jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for his counterpoint work throughout the performance.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith sits out the first 10 minutes of the jam, then returns with a furious electric‑piano burst that adds intensity.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's cymbal work is singled out as exceptional in the improvisational sections.
